message.content: {"verdict": "revise", "score": 0.65, "reasons": ["Artifact largely follows the instruction but ends abruptly in section D, cut off mid-sentence ('... because the Fraunhofer cell is a multi').", "The deliverable naming convention and format requested (efficiency_analysis.md with tables and short charts' descriptions) are not clearly satisfied; artifact is a narrative note rather than an MD file and lacks explicit tables and chart descriptions.", "CSV appendix is not included (only narrative lists); request to include a small CSV appendix of normalized records.", "Ensure the normalization details are explicit and references/links are present (present but verify all sources)."], "guidance": "Produce a complete efficiency_analysis.md file with: (a) a clear table of best efficiencies per category (lab single-junction, lab multi-junction, commercial module) with sources; (b) a concise time-series table/chart descriptions; (c) a comparison section to SQ and detailed-balance limits with explicit numbers for each record; (d) a small CSV appendix listing all normalized records (id, device, category, efficiency, spectrum, concentration, source); (e) ensure the D section is complete and does not cut off; (f) ensure the document includes links to all original sources; (g) save as efficiency_analysis.md."}
